verdict.rationale: LobeHub runs real, large registries: a Skills marketplace with 334,081 SKILL.md bundles and an MCP server directory with over 100,000 ranked listings. Its official market CLI installs a skill with a single `npx @lobehub/market-cli skills install` command, and the desktop app can install MCP connectors. missing for 10: explicit documentation of a one-click in-app install flow from the registry into LobeChat itself, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the install experience.

support.subject: As a power user, I can browse a real skills/plugins registry and install a capability with one command or click

citations.quote: Browse 334,081 Skills built agent-first and open to every stack.
Explore 100,833 MCP Servers, ranked by activity, stability, and community feedback
Desktop can now install and run MCP connectors that live on your machine or your local network.
